name: raj-cage
brief: An ornate hanging gilded iron birdcage big enough for a seated man, Mughal / Rajput palace style, the same design as the attached cage reference. Rounded onion dome top with a finial and a large round hanging ring at the very top. Tall cylindrical body, about twice as tall as the dome: evenly spaced thin vertical gold bars, a band of small scalloped arches under the dome rim and another just above the base. In the centre of the front, a closed tall hinged door outlined in thicker gold with a small empty latch hasp at its middle (NO padlock). Heavy round floor plate base with a scalloped gold rim. Gold and brass metal with deep aubergine outlines, small hot-pink tassels hanging from the dome rim. Empty: nothing inside, the inside is open see-through background between the bars.
subject: prop
